author: PietPaaltjes
quote: F in the chat to pay respect to the old school GTA. The game in it's current state is not worth 80+ euro considering the amount of glitches and abominal FPS rate. And the relationship being the central point of the game is the biggest mistake ever.

author: PietPaaltjes
quote: Ocarina of Time is a timeless masterpiece. Even after 28 years it still effortlessly holds up with anything that is released these days. Nintendo stayed true to the original and it was great to see the game in it's new jacket of graphics. The original always was a 10/10 for me and I recommended it to everyone and this remaster is no different if you ask me.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
